svg.text: 3 separate GKE clusters in asia-south1 · same App-of-Apps pattern · same ESO secrets pipeline · diverging addon footprint between envs · DEV cluster hosts development + qa1 + qa2 namespaces

g.text: Status
deployed
partial / risk
missing
critical / blocker
Source of truth → GitHub: crego-tech/crego-infra · branch main · single repo

Each cluster runs its own ArgoCD instance; pulls argocd-apps/{env}-gcp/ + addons/{env}-gcp/ + overlays/{env}-gcp/ + base/{env}-gcp/. Sync policy automated/prune/selfHeal identical in all envs (incl. PRD ⚠⚠)
DEV CLUSTER · gke-dev
asia-south1 · regional · private nodes · WI on · NetworkPolicy on · 1 cluster, 3 namespaces
Edge — NGINX Ingress Controller (public LB IP)
cert-manager · Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 · staging + prod ClusterIssuer
Path-prefix routing — services on :8000 (Flower :5555) · no URL rewrite
⚠ NGINX install not in GitOps — replicas/version unpinned, default = 1 replica
⚠ HTTP-01 only — no DNS-01 → no wildcard certs, LE rate-limit risk per tenant
Namespaces & workloads (App-of-Apps per env)
development namespace
APIs: omni-api · flow-api (HPA 1-3 CPU 70%)
Web: omni-web · flow-web · Monitor: flower (no HPA)
Workers: omni-celery-{worker,beat} · flow-celery-worker (KEDA: RabbitMQ depth 50 + CPU 80%)
qa1 namespace · QA env-1
Same workload set as development · scaled-down replicas
Pulls overlays/qa1-gcp · base/qa1-gcp · own ArgoCD Application set
qa2 namespace · QA env-2
Same workload set · independent tenant config
Pulls overlays/qa2-gcp · base/qa2-gcp
⚠ All 3 NS share single cluster — noisy-neighbour risk; no ResourceQuota/LimitRange per NS in repo
Stateful data (in-cluster, per namespace)
postgres (PVC 150Gi) · redis (5Gi) · rabbitmq (10Gi) · mongodb (20Gi)
StorageClass: standard · PVC ArgoCD sync-option: Sync=false (data preserved on prune)
⚠ Single replica each · ⚠ No backup CronJob in repo · ⚠ No VolumeSnapshot schedule
Acceptable for DEV ergonomics; QA1/QA2 inherit same posture
Cluster-wide addons (argocd-apps/dev-gcp + addons/dev-gcp)
✓ cert-manager ✓ external-dns ✓ External Secrets Operator (ESO) ✓ KEDA
✗ Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager ✗ OpenTelemetry collector ✗ Loki/Fluent Bit
✗ kube-state-metrics ✗ node-exporter ✗ blackbox / synthetics
⚠ Sentry env vars wired in apps but DSNs empty in config/clients.yaml
GitOps · Secrets · Egress
ArgoCD: argocd-apps/{dev,qa1,qa2}-gcp/ — App-of-Apps · syncs main · prune + selfHeal
Secrets backend: GSM project crego-app-dev · keys app-dev / app-qa1 / app-qa2
ESO ClusterSecretStore cloud-sm · WI: eso-sa KSA per NS → GSA eso-sa@crego-app-dev
Egress: Cloud NAT (AUTO_ONLY) — single regional IP for all outbound
⚠ argocd-repo-secret.yaml contains placeholder GitHub PAT (auth out-of-band)
⚠ AppProjects allow '*' sourceRepos in repo bootstrap
⚠ Egress NetworkPolicy still allows 0.0.0.0/0
PREPROD CLUSTER · gke-preprod
asia-south1 · regional · private nodes · WI on · NetworkPolicy on · 1 cluster, 1 namespace
Edge — NGINX Ingress Controller (public LB IP)
cert-manager · Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 · staging + prod ClusterIssuer
Path-prefix routing — services on :8000 (Flower :5555)
⚠ NGINX install not in GitOps · default = 1 replica
⚠ HTTP-01 only — same wildcard / rate-limit caveats as DEV
Namespace & workloads
preproduction namespace
APIs: omni-api · flow-api (HPA 1-3 CPU 70%)
Web: omni-web · flow-web · Monitor: flower (no HPA, no auth annotation)
Beat (singleton): omni-celery-beat (no PDB, no leader election)
Workers: flow-celery-worker (KEDA on RabbitMQ depth)
⚠ 14 tenant-specific omni-celery-worker variants
(hand-edited in overlays/preprod-gcp/kustomization.yaml ~450 lines)
Use case: client UAT, release candidate verification
⚠ Web/flower replicas: 1 — same posture as DEV
⚠⚠ No PDBs · no podAntiAffinity · same as every other env
Stateful data (in-cluster — DOES NOT mirror PROD)
postgres · redis · rabbitmq · mongodb all in-cluster, single replica, PVC-backed
⚠⚠ PRE topology diverges from PROD — promotion can surprise
Should mirror PROD (Cloud SQL + Memorystore) to be a useful release gate
⚠ USE_EXTERNAL_POSTGRESQL=false in preprod overlay (vs true in prod)
Cluster-wide addons (argocd-apps/preprod-gcp + addons/preprod-gcp)
✓ cert-manager ✓ external-dns ✓ External Secrets Operator (ESO) ✓ KEDA
✗ Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager ✗ OpenTelemetry collector
✗ Centralised logs · ✗ kube-state-metrics · ✗ node-exporter
⚠ Same observability gap as DEV — release candidates fly blind on PRE
GitOps · Secrets · Egress
ArgoCD: argocd-apps/preprod-gcp/ · syncs main · prune + selfHeal · git+ssh repo auth
Secrets backend: GSM project crego-app-preprod · key app-preprod
ESO ClusterSecretStore cloud-sm · WI: eso-sa KSA → GSA
Egress: Cloud NAT (AUTO_ONLY) — single regional IP
⚠ Same auto-sync from main as DEV — no PRE-specific approval gate
⚠ Same NetworkPolicy egress 0.0.0.0/0 issue as DEV
Cluster bootstrapped via cluster/scripts/bootstrap-gcp.sh — no Terraform
PROD CLUSTER · gke-prod
asia-south1 · regional · private nodes · WI on · ⚠⚠ public CP endpoint MAN=0.0.0.0/0
Edge — GKE Gateway API (gke-l7-global-external-managed)
Static IP crego-prod-ip · TLS via cert-map (Google-managed certs)
Security headers (HSTS / CSP / X-XSS) injected on HTTPRoute
NEG-backed (pod IP routing) · per-Service HealthCheckPolicy
⚠ No Cloud Armor / WAF · ⚠ no rate-limit policy in repo
Namespace & workloads
production namespace
APIs: omni-api (req 1000m/2Gi, lim 2000m/4Gi) · flow-api (req 500m/500Mi)
Web: omni-web · flow-web · Monitor: flower
Workers: omni-celery-{worker,beat} · flow-celery-worker
⚠⚠ overlays/prod-gcp/kustomization.yaml overrides replicas: 1 for ALL Deployments
→ defeats HPA (which is defined min=1 max=3 for APIs)
⚠ flower exposed without ingress auth annotation
⚠ readOnlyRootFilesystem: false on api/web/worker
⚠⚠ Zero PDBs · zero podAntiAffinity / topologySpreadConstraints
Image refs: short-SHA tags (mutable, not digest-pinned)
Stateful data (managed cloud services)
✓ Cloud SQL Postgres (private IP) — HA + PITR variable-driven via Terraform
✓ Memorystore Redis (VPC peering)
External MongoDB (DSN injected via ESO; not managed in this repo)
⚠⚠ RabbitMQ STILL in-cluster: single replica, no HA, no backup, no PDB
Cluster-wide addons (addons/prod-gcp/ contains ESO ONLY)
✓ External Secrets Operator (ESO)
⚠⚠ ✗ cert-manager ✗ external-dns ✗ KEDA ✗ Prometheus stack ✗ OTel
⚠ Either confirm these are installed out-of-band, or copy preprod-gcp's addon set
⚠⚠ Without KEDA, celery workers cannot scale on RabbitMQ depth in PRD
GitOps · Secrets · Egress
ArgoCD: argocd-apps/prod-gcp/ · git+ssh repo auth
⚠⚠ targetRevision: main + auto-sync + prune + selfHeal — any commit deploys to PRD
⚠⚠ AppProject prod-project allows sourceRepos: ['*']
Secrets backend: GSM project crego-app-prod · key app-prod · WI eso-sa
Egress: Cloud NAT (AUTO_ONLY) — single regional IP
⚠ VPC firewall allows ALL protocols/ports inside subnet/pod/svc CIDRs (terraform/modules/gcp-vpc)
Provisioned by Terraform (only env that is) → terraform/environments/gcp/prod
Shared concerns (apply to all 3 clusters)
⚠⚠ Single region asia-south1 — no DR cluster, no GKE Backup, no Velero, no PV snapshot schedule, no cross-region replica
⚠⚠ No Pod Security Admission labels on any namespace · no PDBs · no podAntiAffinity / topologySpreadConstraints
⚠ No CMEK on PD-SSD / Cloud SQL / GSM · ⚠ No K8s API audit log sink · ⚠ No CODEOWNERS / branch protection asserted in repo
